instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/part.step, /home/user/Desktop/fixture.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Use the fixture as check geometry in FreeCAD Path/CAM. While machining the top pocket, every low-level toolpath point must keep at least 3 mm clearance from the fixture. Tool definition: T1 is an end mill for the top pocket while respecting fixture clearance. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-10.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
